'''Kolrak''' was a lunar [[City/Legends|city]] built by the [[Anarrian]]s' on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Secava]] orbiting the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Altiria/Anarris]]. The city was named for a historical military leader. The city suffered heavy casualties after an attack led by the [[Altiri/Legends|Altiri]] colonists from [[Priva]].<ref name="TUR" />
